Essays on the Tamil country, its dynasties, the Śaṅgam age, the Purāṇas and the Mauryan connections of the South (London and Madras, 1911).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy of the Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Ancient India · Krishnaswami Aiyangar, Sakkottai, 1871-1947 · 1911, 488 scanned pages. Published 1911; Sakkottai Krishnaswami Aiyangar died 1947; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
